abilities.name: The Speed of Death
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Clattering Procession unit that used a Charge or Retreat ability this turn, is not in combat, and is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ethereal
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly Nighthaunt units.

abilities.name: Spectral Swiftness
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Clattering Procession unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Pitiless Reapers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Clattering Procession unit that passed across any enemy units this phase to use this ability, then pick 1 of those enemy units to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the Clattering Procession unit that passed across the target. Add 1 to the roll if any friendly Clattering Procession Black Coaches passed across the target this phase. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

powers.name: Spectral Lashes
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Clattering Procession Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Clattering Procession unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

powers.name: Fell Riders
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Clattering Procession Wizard to cast this spell, pick the caster and up to two visible friendly Clattering Procession units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs

abilities.name: Dancing Blades

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
